preconditions.name: ARM_WIN1_s0::harm_pathway_discriminative
preconditions.description: Stage-H trained the harm landscape: harm_eval output RANGE over in-distribution z_world clears the 603n non-vacuity floor.

preconditions.name: ARM_WIN1_s0::worldforward_action_spread
preconditions.description: e2.world_forward is action-discriminative: cross-action max pairwise L2 of z_world_1 (the ARC-065 GAP-A collapse check).
preconditions.control: the 5 discrete env actions from the live theta summary, in-band ticks

preconditions.name: ARM_WIN1_s0::approach_recede_gap
preconditions.description: THE statistic C1/C2 route on: |mean(m_30 | APPROACH) - mean(m_30 | RECEDE)|. _restraint compares exactly these two subset means, and they EXCLUDE the stay action and every blocked move -- so the 5-action range is a superset that can be green while this contrast is identically zero. A collapsed gap means the criterion is starved, not falsified.

preconditions.name: ARM_WIN1_s0::arf_shallow_headroom
preconditions.description: C1 needs room to show a lift: arf is bounded above by 1.0, so a shallow-depth fraction already at ceiling makes the >= ARF_MARGIN lift unreachable regardless of the substrate.

preconditions.name: ARM_WIN1_s0::inband_tick_count
preconditions.description: Enough hazard-reachable-but-not-realised E3 ticks to estimate arf.
preconditions.control: E3 ticks with nearest-hazard distance in [2,6] and both classes non-empty

preconditions.name: ARM_WIN1_s0::rolled_out_zworld_bounded
preconditions.description: Numerical stability: rolled-out z_world norm stayed below the explosion ceiling.
preconditions.control: max over every rollout step of every in-band tick

preconditions.name: ARM_WIN1_s0::grid_model_match_rate
preconditions.description: The driver's env movement model (which defines APPROACH/RECEDE) agrees with the env's actual post-step position.
